title: Convertible Top - Component Location
introduction:
The convertible top combines a folding frame, fabric-support pieces, seals, smart motor assemblies and position-sensing components. The frame drawing helps you identify the parts that move and support the roof. The separate sensor-and-switch drawing shows where the control system receives its inputs. Match each numbered callout to the key beside that particular drawing.

**Understanding the motor names:** MRCMA means Moveable Roof Control Module A, and MRCMB means Moveable Roof Control Module B. The [convertible-top overview](#/document/G1708665) describes these as smart electric motors; the module names refer to their electronic control role. MRCMA is the primary controller. The [system-operation reference](#/document/G1708666) explains how they coordinate motor motion and monitor position.

**Source wording clarification:** Item 7 in the frame key has a misplaced “RH.” Read its side labels as MRCMA on the left-hand (LH) side and MRCMB on the right-hand (RH) side. The original table is retained below so you can compare it with the [source PDF](/source/G1708664.pdf).
